evidence:
Authored procedures satisfy the assigned source check. With F=.qc-cache/hireops-2026-10-01-transaction-hardening-r3/task, F/tests/gates/constraints/prompt.md explicitly requires ordinary UI creation followed by separate-context sign-in/readback. F/tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:43,51,53,59,61,65 requires successful UI controls, concurrent requests, persisted readbacks, stale-state transitions, actual prepare/commit and one real restart. F/tests/scored/polish/judge.toml:23 requires submitting an invalid revision, observing refusal, preserving the valid edit, correcting and saving; :59 requires forwarding an actual successful commit, suppressing response delivery, then retrying the same saved operation. Its prompt.md:12-14 distinguishes before-dispatch interruption from post-settlement response loss and requires actual successful recovery. These procedures cannot be fulfilled from first paint. Calendar calculations use supplied dates/fixed reference, so no wall-clock waiting is relevant. F/instruction.md:5 explicitly requests a desktop workspace and excludes theme switching/special phone layout; F/tests/scored/visual/prompt.md:10 appropriately reviews desktop screens/forms/details. No animation, theme or responsive behavior is graded, so no such toggle/resize is missing.

Raw evidence supports interaction feasibility and selected golden behavior. local/batch-ui.cjs:24-55 clicks Preview/Commit, waits for committed/refusal states, checks retained input values, forwards then aborts a real response, and clicks retry. Its results.json reports all five observations passing, including one forwarded status-200 commit and no extra effects after UI retry. local/targeted-golden.cjs:32-45 observes an actual 409 preparation refusal, retained valid inputs and successful corrected commit. local/legacy-ui/results.json reports revision/refusal and rescission interruption/retry observations. The actual MCP requests/responses ids 4-6 and 9 independently show UI clicks/waits, newContext readback, held-response release, and forwarded response loss (forwarded=1, realStatus=200, browserObservedFailure=true, persistedDespiteLostResponse=true). I verified all 10 cited raw artifact hashes against the current raw index and all 54 recorded app-source bindings against the frozen solution; evidence/34/hash-verification.json records all_match=true.

Risk remains true because these are selected scripted product and MCP-feasibility observations, not execution of the complete configured LLM judges. The raw index explicitly records that configured grading/workload and Oracle/target scores are absent. This Note does not certify that all required interactions fit the configured budgets or were performed by those judges; no new provider/Docker run, portal run or score was invented.
counterexample: Broken-app check: a polished static preview or editor that never submits could look correct at first paint, but it cannot satisfy the successful UI creation/readback prerequisite, actual refusal followed by correction, or saved-operation retry procedures. A commit that silently settles and displays success after a suppressed response likewise fails the explicit uncertainty/retry observation. Conforming-alternative check: a desktop-only app with native validation, expandable details, different labels/routes and a read-only retained-date Retry confirmation is permitted by the brief and the Polish/Visual prompts; missing mobile/theme controls or reference DOM selectors must not fail it. These are source-level counterexamples, not configured judge mutation scores.
